Weed Control & Removal in the Blue Mountains

Weeds cleared and kept under control — hand weeding, edging and ongoing programs that keep your beds, paths and lawns clean and healthy.

Weeds take over fast up here, competing with your plants and making a garden look neglected. We clear them properly — by hand and at the root where it matters — then help keep them down for good.

Whether it’s a one-off clean-up of overgrown beds or a regular program to stay on top of them, we clear weeds from garden beds, paths, paving and lawn edges and leave everything tidy.

What’s included

  • Hand weeding and root removal
  • Overgrown bed and path clean-ups
  • Ongoing weed-control programs
  • Weeds cleared from paving and lawn edges
  • Green waste removed
  • Follow-up mulching to suppress regrowth

Paving, Pavers & Stone in the Blue Mountains

Paving, pavers, pebble and natural stone — driveways, courtyards and feature paths laid on solid bases so they stay put.

Good paving is all in the base. On Mountains ground with frost and movement, a proper compacted base and drainage is the difference between paving that lasts and paving that lifts.

We lay everything from clean modern pavers to natural sandstone and decorative pebble, matched to your home and garden.

What’s included

  • Driveways and entertaining areas
  • Courtyards, paths and stepping stones
  • Natural stone and sandstone
  • Decorative pebble and gravel
  • Compacted bases and drainage
  • Clean, even finishing
